package.description: Automatically remove silences from audio and video files. 100% local processing, one-time payment.

en-US.description: Automatically remove silences from audio and video files. 100% local processing, one-time payment.
en-US.longDescription:
VoxCut is a Windows desktop app that automatically detects and removes
silences from audio and video files. All processing happens locally on
your computer -- no upload, no internet connection required. One-time
payment, no subscription.
en-US.name: VoxCut
